title: Document
description: Canonical document entity produced by document-intelligence. Represents a single legal or regulatory document.

document_id.description: Unique identifier for the canonical document. Format: doc_{ulid}

artifact_id.description: ID of the raw artifact this document was derived from.

source_id.description: ID of the source. Carried through for lineage.

source_version_id.description: ID of the source version. Carried through for lineage.

run_id.description: ID of the run that produced the raw artifact.

content.description: Full text content of the document, if extracted.

content_type.description: Original content type of the source artifact.

content_docling.description: Structured DoclingDocument JSON produced by the docling pipeline (ADR-0010). A first-class canonical artifact intended for downstream consumption.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the document belongs to. MUST use normalized values from contracts/vocabularies/jurisdiction.json (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

document_type.description: Normalized document type classification. MUST use values from contracts/vocabularies/document-type.json. Upstream mapping of raw extraction labels to these values is required before canonical output.

type.description: Source-native legal instrument type label (for example from Fedlex).

number.description: Source-native document number or citation identifier.

source.description: External source system code (for example: fedlex).

status.description: Source-native lifecycle status (for example: In force).

inForceTo.description: Date until which the document remains in force, when known.

abstractUri.description: Stable abstract URI for the legal instrument (for example ELI URI).

applicableTo.description: Date until which applicability is defined, when provided by upstream source.

documentDate.description: Official document date provided by the upstream legal source.

inForceSince.description: Date from which the document entered into force.

applicableFrom.description: Date from which applicability starts, when provided by upstream source.

language.description: Primary language of the document content. ISO 639-1 code.

structural_path.description: Intrinsic document hierarchy as a delimited path (e.g., 'OR › Gesellschaftsrecht › Verantwortlichkeit'). Represents stable structural position derived from document analysis, not a UI artifact. May evolve to a structured array representation in the future.

effective_date.description: Date the document became effective, if applicable.

processed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the document was processed.

processing_version.description: Version of the processing pipeline that produced this document.
